subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------LK.IMP.
description: Second diagram on page 512, paired with VT-U-PT × POST above. This one names the structural condition under which principle-information actually carries linkage-implication into political functionalism: PRI-INFO (principle information — the form's working informational frame) crossed with LK-IMP (linkage implications — what the form's principles structurally link to). PRI-INFO sits centrally with the subject-arrow, its label written 'prin.info.'; the main line rises straight from it to LK-IMP; (PO)STF (point of source transfer) branches from LK-IMP's dot to the upper-left, and TH-CONT (thrust continuance) branches from the main line to the upper-right. LK-IMP sits centrally above as partner-axis. OP-SPD (option spread) branches from the TH-CONT line down to the right; TH-AFF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment) drops from the OP-SPD line to the bottom-center, and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches from the OP-SPD line to the right.
